name: Fog Walker
shortDescription: A tall wet shape that does not keep footprints.
lookDescription: A tall wet shape of wool and peat stands in the hollow and does not keep footprints.
examineDescription: The Fog Walker is wool and peat and weather that learned to walk. Not a deer-god lecture. A hunger that used the Collegium bronze for a mouth. It will not square up for fewer than 3 Collegians. Fog thickens when you lock. The count is still three. When it falls the hollow should smell like rain on a hearth-stone, not sweetness.
lockNarration: Fog thickens and does not keep footprints.
victoryNarration: The Fog Walker thins until the hollow smells like rain on a hearth-stone. Not sweetness. The fog is only weather again.
